content.text: {"quote_faithful": "yes", "verdict": "confirmed", "evidence_kind": "missing_justification", "fatal": "yes", "explanation": "The quote is verbatim and is exactly the inductive step carrying part (i), on which the entire upper bound (\u00a74) rests. The text never establishes the facts the induction needs: (a) that each resulting array is a multiset of at most s positive numbers (\"at most s column-blocks\" is asserted, never derived from one cut being made), (b) that each has total at most (T-d)/2 \u2014 the parenthetical only claims the two totals \"add to T-d\", which does not give each \u2264 (T-d)/2, and under the natural reading of \"successive vertical portions\" the swept portions total the maximum height, not T (e.g. columns 0.9, 0.1: portions 1/3, 0.4667, 0.1 sum to 0.9, not T-d=2/3), and (c) that a split of a derived level-array corresponds to a legal split of an actual stick piece. The external file lemmas/refinement.md is not part of the write-up."}
